Active player: The player whose turn it is.
Priority: The opportunity to take a legal game action or pass.
Stack: The zone where spells and many abilities wait to resolve.
Resolve: Apply a spell or ability as it leaves the stack.
Permanent: A card or token on the battlefield, such as a land or creature.
Land drop: Playing a land; normally one per turn, not a spell.
Mana: A resource used to pay costs, produced by lands and other effects.
Mana pool: The mana you currently have available to spend.
Generic mana: A numerical part of a cost that can be paid with mana of any type.
Color identity: The colors allowed in a Commander deck based on its commander.
Mulligan: A procedure to replace an opening hand and follow bottoming instructions as applicable.
Main phase: A part of your turn when sorcery-speed plays normally happen.
Instant speed: An action you can normally take when you have priority, if other restrictions permit.
Summoning sickness: Informal name for restrictions on attacking and tap-symbol abilities for a creature without haste.
Haste: A keyword that lets a creature attack and use tap-symbol abilities without waiting for a later turn.
Declare attackers: The combat step when attacking creatures are selected.
Declare blockers: The combat step when defending creatures are selected.
Combat damage: Damage assigned and dealt in combat according to rules and abilities.
Trample: An ability affecting how an attacking creature assigns excess combat damage.
Flying: A combat evasion ability; generally blocked only by creatures with flying or reach.
Graveyard: A zone where many used, destroyed or discarded cards go.
Exile: A separate game zone; cards here are not normally playable.
Command zone: A zone used for commanders and certain other game objects.
Commander tax: An extra two generic mana for each earlier cast of that commander from the command zone.
Commander damage: Combat damage tracked per commander; 21 from the same commander causes a loss.
Token: A non-card object representing a permanent.
Counter: A marker affecting a permanent or player as specified.
Legal action: An action currently permitted by the game rules and available through Argentum.
Triggered ability: An ability that begins with when, whenever or at and triggers from an event.
Activated ability: An ability expressed as Cost: Effect, activated by paying its cost.
Auto-pass: A UI shortcut that passes priority on the player’s behalf until a stopping condition.
